subject: Sterile activation ops review: air-gapped image activation playback & verification
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sara Li <sara@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Sterile activation ops review: image rotation and custody playback

Sara, thanks again for taking this on. We need to run a full "playback" of BluePeak's sterile activation flow for the v2.1 image before field handoff. Primary goals: validate signature verification, operator handback procedure, and the courier chain-of-custody PDF you mentioned.

What we need from BluePeak for the dry run (ideally by EOD Friday):
- Activation manifest (static): image SHA256, build metadata, activation window, operator identity fields. Reference: attached activation-manifest-v2.1.json
- Detached signature for image bundle (PKCS7 or .sig): attached signed-image-v2.1.tar.gz.sig
- Chain-of-custody export (signed PDF) describing physical courier steps and timestamps: attach courier-chain-of-custody.pdf

On our side we'll exercise the following:
1) Verify detached signature against pinned root key (redwood-root-hsm) and record verification log.
2) Offline hash verification (sha256sum) of the image on operator workstation, then cross-check against manifest.
3) Simulate operator handback: operator signs receipt, we run acceptance script (offline) and produce an acceptance artifact.
4) Execute rollback/fallback path if verification fails (manual revoke + manual override steps).

Notes / constraints:
- We will only accept signatures produced by BluePeak's provisioning HSM (attestation statement requested). If you cannot provide an HSM attestation, provide key provenance and signing timeline.
- Activation window: prefer 03/29 02:00-06:00 UTC (low traffic) but we can be flexible.

Please confirm the attestation format you can provide and whether the courier can produce time-stamped signed receipts (PDF must include courier device serial). If you have any pre-recorded verification logs for a prior test, please include them.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: activation-manifest-v2.1.json (metadata stub), signed-image-v2.1.tar.gz.sig (detached signature stub), courier-chain-of-custody.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Sara Li <sara@bluepeak.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: BluePeak Systems Ops <ops@bluepeak.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sterile activation ops review: image rotation and custody playback

Hi Naomi — thanks for the clear checklist. We can run the dry-run and provide the artifacts. Answers inline below.


On Thu, 23 Mar 2028 at 09:15 Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
> Sara, thanks again for taking this on. We need to run a full "playback" of BluePeak's sterile activation flow for the v2.1 image before field handoff. Primary goals: validate signature verification, operator handback procedure, and the courier chain-of-custody PDF you mentioned.
> 
> What we need from BluePeak for the dry run (ideally by EOD Friday):
> - Activation manifest (static): image SHA256, build metadata, activation window, operator identity fields. Reference: attached activation-manifest-v2.1.json
> - Detached signature for image bundle (PKCS7 or .sig): attached signed-image-v2.1.tar.gz.sig
> - Chain-of-custody export (signed PDF) describing physical courier steps and timestamps: attach courier-chain-of-custody.pdf

We can provide all three items. Quick answers:
- Signature format: PKCS7 detached + raw .sig (we'll attach both). Signed with our production HSM (Thales Luna) — we can export an attestation statement (TPM-like quote) and include the HSM signing certificate chain.
- Courier receipts: our courier tablets sign with an MDM-backed device cert; PDFs include device serial and timestamp and we will include the courier manifest.
- Activation window: 03/29 02:00-06:00 UTC works for our ops team.

Proposed dry-run timeline:
- 03/29 01:45 UTC — BluePeak transfers sealed image to handoff staging (encrypted disk image on courier medium)
- 03/29 02:00 UTC — Operator verification begins at your staging site
- 03/29 03:15 UTC — Acceptance tests complete / acceptance artifact produced
- 03/29 03:30 UTC — Operator handback + signed receipt

Two quick questions for your team:
1) Do you require a full HSM attestation blob or is the certificate chain + signing timestamp sufficient?
2) For rollback we will retain a signed revocation envelope — do you want us to publish that to the runbook link or hand it over only if requested?

I attached the initial artifacts and the courier chain-of-custody PDF as separate files. Let me know if you want us to send through a sealed physical test first (we can schedule a courier to drop at your staging room next week).

Best,
Sara Li
Head of Field Ops
BluePeak Systems

Attachments (sent): bluepeak-activation-manifest-v2.1.json, bluepeak-signed-image-v2.1.pkcs7, courier-chain-of-custody.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Mar 2028 12:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sterile activation ops review: image rotation and custody playback

Looping in internal owners / quick plan.

On Thu, 23 Mar 2028 at 11:03 Sara Li <sara@bluepeak.com> wrote:
> We can provide all three items. Quick answers:
> - Signature format: PKCS7 detached + raw .sig (we'll attach both). Signed with our production HSM (Thales Luna) — we can export an attestation statement (TPM-like quote) and include the HSM signing certificate chain.
> - Courier receipts: our courier tablets sign with an MDM-backed device cert; PDFs include device serial and timestamp and we will include the courier manifest.

Thanks — this looks good. Proposed internal assignments: 
- Marissa: run the offline acceptance script and record the verification log; create the acceptance artifact and upload to the secure Drive link.
- Karthik: update the private-deploy runbook with the HSM attestation verification step + explicit sha256check commands and the manual revoke flow.
- Naomi: confirm acceptance criteria and the minimal attestation fields we require (we should be explicit for compliance).

Checklist to validate during the dry run:
1) Verify certificate chain and PKCS7 signature verification steps (log artifact).
2) Verify detached .sig raw verify (sha256 matches manifest).
3) Confirm courier PDF has device serial and that timestamp aligns with our watch (time sync check).
4) Produce acceptance artifact (signed by operator) and generate an ops ticket with acceptance hash.
5) Run failover: simulate corrupted image -> follow revocation + manual override and confirm rollback completed.

I'll coordinate ops scheduling with BluePeak. Marissa / Karthik, please confirm you can take these items and if we need procurement to validate courier insurance.

-Jonas

Jonas Weber
Senior Engineering Manager, Runtime & Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sara Li <sara@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Mar 2028 14:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sterile activation ops review: image rotation and custody playback

Sara — perfect, thank you. Confirming our acceptance of the 03/29 02:00-06:00 UTC window for the dry run. Final items we need before the run: 
- HSM attestation: the Thales quote + signing certificate chain is sufficient for us. Please annotate the attestation with the signing slot identifier.
- Manifest additions: include build-id, builder commit hash, and a short list of applied mitigations (kernel hardening flags) so our scanner can run offline checks.
- Revocation envelope: please upload the signed revocation envelope to the secure runbook link ahead of activation (we will mark it restricted).

Operational asks for the dry-run itself: 
- Marissa: please run the attached acceptance script (we'll provide it in Drive) and capture the full stdout/stderr. Produce acceptance artifact: acceptance-<timestamp>.json signed by the local operator.
- Karthik: add a one-page appendix to the runbook describing how to manually override acceptance in an emergency (explicit commands, where to find revocation envelope).

If BluePeak can schedule a courier to physically deliver the sealed test medium on 03/28 (preferred), set ETA 09:00 local staging room; that lets us pre-stage checks without opening the medium. If courier delivery is delayed, we will run a remote transfer test with an encrypted disk image. 

Please confirm you will upload the three files to the Drive link and include any pre-run logs you already have. Once we have artifacts I will send a short DocuSign SOW addendum for the dry-run authorization (link will be included in the runbook).

Thanks everyone — this is a critical compliance checkpoint so let's keep notes tight.

Naomi Feldman
Director, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: activation-manifest-v2.1.json, signed-image-v2.1.tar.gz.sig, courier-chain-of-custody.pdf
